newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ube Chemical, Calceed say to merge next April.
newsitem.headline: Ube Chemical, Calceed say to merge next April.

text.p: Ube Chemical Industries Co Ltd and Calceed Co Ltd said on Friday that they will merge on April 1, 1997.
The two companies are group firms of Ube Industries Ltd.
The firms companies said in a statement that the merger was aimed at strengthening their international competitiveness in quicklime products amid intensifying competition from cheaper imports.
Ube Chemical Industries' production of sea-water magnesia, which is used for firebricks and other fireproof industrial materials, makes up 22 percent of the world market.
Calceed supplies quicklime to Ube Chemical Industries.
